headline: ‘The Odyssey’ Hired Their Viking Ship. They Say It Came Back Damaged.
context: A Swedish Viking center said its vessel was used in the filming of Christopher Nolan’s epic but needed repairs when it was returned. Now, the center is seeking compensation.

sources.name: The New York Times
